description.zh: 图片集信息。仅支持IPCamera场景，MediaType需为video。
description.en: Image set information. Supports only the IPCamera scenario, and MediaType must be video.

description.zh:
需要入库的视频、音频或图片文件的地址，请勿使用临时地址，需保证源文件可以被访问。

> 请确认您的文件名正确且所在Bucket与接口调用地域一致，否则可能导致找不到文件或接口调用失败。
>- OSS地址（推荐）：oss://[Bucket名称]/[文件路径]，例如oss://[example-bucket-****]/[object_path-****]。
>- HTTP地址：公网可下载的地址，例如http://example-test-****.mp4。
description.en:
The URL of the video, audio, or image file that you want to import to the search library.

Note: Make sure that you specify a correct file name and the bucket in which the file resides is in the same region where this operation is called. Otherwise, the file cannot be found or the operation may fail.

Specify an Object Storage Service (OSS) URL in the following format: oss\://\[Bucket name]/\[File path]. For example, you can specify oss\://\[example-bucket-****]/\[object\_path-****].

Specify an HTTP URL in the following format: public endpoint. For example, you can specify http\://example-test-\*\*\*\*.mp4.

description.zh: 媒资ID。具有唯一性，不填会自动生成。
description.en: The ID of the media asset. Each media ID is unique. If you leave this parameter empty, a media ID is automatically generated for this parameter.

description.zh:
媒资类型。默认值video。
- video视频
- image图片
- audio音频
description.en:
The type of the media asset. Valid values:

- video (default)

- image

- audio

description.zh:
媒资信息。JSON字符串。支持字段：
- title，标题，string类型
- customFields，自定义字段，JSONObject，参数不支持修改；支持Int型intField1、string型strField1、strField2
搜索库名称。需要调用CreateSearchLib接口提前建立好搜索库。
description.en: The name of the search library. Default value: ims-default-search-lib.

title.en: Insert a media asset into the search library

descriptions.zh:
### 前提条件
插入媒资到搜索库前，需要调用[CreateSearchLib](~~2584454~~)接口建立好搜索库。
descriptions.en:
### Prerequisites

Before inserting a media asset into the search library, you must call the [CreateSearchLib](~~2584454~~) API to create the search library.
